description: This file defines the InvestRepository class, which handles database interactions related to 'invest' entities, including retrieving lists of investment records with optional filters by payment or transaction.

classes.name: InvestRepository
classes.description: Repository class responsible for fetching investment records from the database, providing methods for listing investments with optional pagination and filtering by payment or transaction.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of investments with optional offset and limit for pagination.

methods.name: getListByPayment
methods.description: Retrieves a list of investments filtered by a specific payment identifier.

methods.name: getListByTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a list of investments filtered by a specific transaction identifier.
